overview: Create smaller JPEG, PNG, and WebP copies without changing originals.
capabilities: Collision-safe copies, cancellation cleanup, and savings results
permissions: Read images chosen in the native picker
Save new copies in a folder chosen for writing
getting_started: Open Image Optimizer and choose up to 64 JPEG, PNG, or WebP images.
Choose an output folder, quality, and maximum dimension.
Optimize copies. Completed copies stay in the chosen folder; cancellation discards unfinished output.
changelog: v0.4.0 - Replaced path-based commands with native file grants and Host-owned image conversion.
